title: RCP/RCLM v4.5: Phase 15–16 Results-Only Archive
description: Results-and-authority-evidence-only publication for private Executable Core v4 Phases 15 and 16. It preserves exact safe result records, source/workflow/artifact identities, timestamps, report hashes, byte-identical safe authority archives, cross-platform worker-free replay evidence, adversarial rejection evidence, and the Phase 16 long-trajectory scaling conclusions. The Phase 15/16 Lean and Python implementation, tests, workflows, model weights, candidate packages, hidden tasks, answer stores, mutation programs, and private runtime payloads remain private. Gate E remains open; the next executable phase is Phase 17.
